method_semantics.prompting: Frozen F2 reader receives the intervention text through full attention; there is no trainable adapter.
method_semantics.lora_matched: Frozen F2 reader with the parameter-matched query/value LoRA adapter trained in F2.
method_semantics.loreft: Intervention-conditioned rank-16 residual representation transform on all 16 editable world tokens.
method_semantics.task_vector_add: One intervention-specific 768-dimensional vector is added uniformly to all 16 editable world tokens.
method_semantics.router: State-and-command-conditioned softmax mixture of canonical O1, O2, and O3 experts.
method_semantics.o1: Canonical intervention-specific fixed vector with one distinct vector per editable world token.
method_semantics.o2: Canonical intervention-conditioned low-rank additive operator trained in F2.
method_semantics.o3: Canonical state-gated low-rank operator trained in F2.

execution.checkpoint_selection: final registered operator step after frozen-reader initialization

random_init_floor.operator_methods: The identically instantiated method before its first optimizer update.
random_init_floor.lora_matched: The installed LoRA adapter before loading its trained F2 weights.
random_init_floor.prompting: Identical to prompting because prompting has zero trainable adapter parameters; this degeneracy is reported explicitly.

law_scoring.identity: no-command prediction versus factual SCM state
law_scoring.idempotence: two identical commands versus one-command prediction and intervened SCM state
law_scoring.commutation: two distinct-target commands in both orders versus each other and the joint-intervention SCM state
law_scoring.last_write_wins: opposite then final same-target command versus the final-only prediction and final-intervention SCM state
law_scoring.primary: per-law SCM correctness delta trained minus method-matched random initialization
